title: Let the Perfect One keep your standing
summary: Standing is safest when the Perfect One, not the crowd, preserves it. Receive the dignity already being given.
takeaway: Receive the dignity already being given.
lifeApplication: Before defending your name, let the body stand still and the mouth stay quiet for a beat. Ask who is really responsible for keeping your honor intact.

source.shortMeaning: Standing is safest when the Perfect One, not the crowd, preserves it.
source.lifeApplication: Before defending your name, ask who is truly keeping your honor intact.
